component_mappings <- create_component_mappings()

get_driver_attributes <- function(character) {
  driver_name <- character
  mapping_row <- which(component_mappings$character_map$RecordName == character)
  
  if (length(mapping_row) > 0) {
    driver_name <- component_mappings$character_map$ComponentName[mapping_row[1]]
  }
  
  driver_row <- drivers %>% filter(Driver == driver_name)
  
  if (nrow(driver_row) == 0) {
    possible_matches <- agrep(driver_name, drivers$Driver, max.distance = 0.3, value = TRUE)
    if (length(possible_matches) > 0) {
      driver_row <- drivers %>% filter(Driver == possible_matches[1])
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(driver_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(driver_row)
}

get_vehicle_attributes <- function(vehicle_name) {

  mapped_name <- vehicle_name
  mapping_row <- which(component_mappings$vehicle_map$RecordName == vehicle_name)
  
  if (length(mapping_row) > 0) {
    mapped_name <- component_mappings$vehicle_map$ComponentName[mapping_row[1]]
  }
  
  vehicle_row <- vehicles %>% filter(Vehicle == mapped_name)
  
  if (nrow(vehicle_row) == 0) {
    possible_matches <- agrep(mapped_name, vehicles$Vehicle, max.distance = 0.3, value = TRUE)
    if (length(possible_matches) > 0) {
      vehicle_row <- vehicles %>% filter(Vehicle == possible_matches[1])
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(vehicle_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(vehicle_row)
}

get_tire_attributes <- function(tire_name) {

  mapped_name <- tire_name
  mapping_row <- which(component_mappings$tires_map$RecordName == tire_name)
  
  if (length(mapping_row) > 0) {
    mapped_name <- component_mappings$tires_map$ComponentName[mapping_row[1]]
  }
  
  tire_row <- tires %>% filter(Tire == mapped_name)
  
  if (nrow(tire_row) == 0) {
    possible_matches <- agrep(mapped_name, tires$Tire, max.distance = 0.3, value = TRUE)
    if (length(possible_matches) > 0) {
      tire_row <- tires %>% filter(Tire == possible_matches[1])
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(tire_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(tire_row)
}

get_glider_attributes <- function(glider_name) {

  mapped_name <- glider_name
  mapping_row <- which(component_mappings$glider_map$RecordName == glider_name)
  
  if (length(mapping_row) > 0) {
    mapped_name <- component_mappings$glider_map$ComponentName[mapping_row[1]]
  }

  glider_row <- gliders %>% filter(Glider == mapped_name)

  if (nrow(glider_row) == 0) {
    possible_matches <- agrep(mapped_name, gliders$Glider, max.distance = 0.3, value = TRUE)
    if (length(possible_matches) > 0) {
      glider_row <- gliders %>% filter(Glider == possible_matches[1])
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(glider_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(glider_row)
}

```{r}
# Count characters 
character_counts <- records %>%
  count(Character, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename(Count = n)

# Count the combinations from word record
combinations_counts <- records %>%
  group_by(Character, Vehicle, Tires, Glider) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), AvgScore = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Calculate the scores 
score_stats <- records %>%
  summarise(
    MinScore = min(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaxScore = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    AvgScore = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    MedianScore = median(Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
get_driver_attributes <- function(character) {
  driver_row <- drivers %>% filter(Driver == character)
  if (nrow(driver_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(driver_row)
}

get_vehicle_attributes <- function(vehicle_name) {
  vehicle_row <- vehicles %>% filter(Vehicle == vehicle_name)
  if (nrow(vehicle_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(vehicle_row)
}

get_tire_attributes <- function(tire_name) {
  tire_row <- tires %>% filter(Tire == tire_name)
  if (nrow(tire_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(tire_row)
}

get_glider_attributes <- function(glider_name) {
  glider_row <- gliders %>% filter(Glider == glider_name)
  if (nrow(glider_row) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(glider_row)
}

attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")

records_with_attributes <- records %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DriverFound = !is.null(get_driver_attributes(Character)),
    VehicleFound = !is.null(get_vehicle_attributes(Vehicle)),
    TireFound = !is.null(get_tire_attributes(Tires)),
    GliderFound = !is.null(get_glider_attributes(Glider))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

matching_stats <- records_with_attributes %>%
  summarise(
    TotalRecords = n(),
    DriverMatches = sum(DriverFound),
    VehicleMatches = sum(VehicleFound),
    TireMatches = sum(TireFound),
    GliderMatches = sum(GliderFound),
    CompleteMatches = sum(DriverFound & VehicleFound & TireFound & GliderFound)
  )

print("matching_stats:")
print(matching_stats)
```



```{r}
# Only keep records that all components match
matched_records <- records_with_attributes %>%
  filter(DriverFound & VehicleFound & TireFound & GliderFound) %>%
  select(-DriverFound, -VehicleFound, -TireFound, -GliderFound)

# Calculate different attributes of components
calculate_combined_attributes <- function(character, vehicle, tire, glider) {
  driver_attr <- get_driver_attributes(character)
  vehicle_attr <- get_vehicle_attributes(vehicle)
  tire_attr <- get_tire_attributes(tire)
  glider_attr <- get_glider_attributes(glider)
  
  if (is.null(driver_attr) || is.null(vehicle_attr) || 
      is.null(tire_attr) || is.null(glider_attr)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Character = character,
    Vehicle = vehicle,
    Tires = tire,
    Glider = glider
  )
  
  for (attr in attributes) {
    result[[attr]] <- driver_attr[[attr]] + 
      vehicle_attr[[attr]] + 
      tire_attr[[attr]] + 
      glider_attr[[attr]]
  }
  
  return(result)
}

records_with_combined_attributes <- matched_records %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    combined_attrs = list(calculate_combined_attributes(
      Character, Vehicle, Tires, Glider
    ))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check
records_with_combined_attributes <- records_with_combined_attributes %>%
  filter(!is.null(combined_attrs))

# Extract the individual attributes from the combined_attrs list
for (attr in attributes) {
  records_with_combined_attributes[[attr]] <- 
    sapply(records_with_combined_attributes$combined_attrs, 
           function(x) if(!is.null(x)) x[[attr]] else NA)
}

# Remove secondary columns
records_with_combined_attributes <- records_with_combined_attributes %>%
  select(-combined_attrs)
```

```{r}
plot_attribute_distribution <- function(dataset, title) {
  attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                  "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                  "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")

  long_data <- dataset %>%
    select(c(2, all_of(attributes))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(attributes), 
                 names_to = "Attribute", 
                 values_to = "Value")
  

  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Attribute, y = Value)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Attribute Distributions -", title),
         y = "Value", x = "Attribute")
}

p1 <- plot_attribute_distribution(drivers, "Drivers")
p2 <- plot_attribute_distribution(vehicles, "Vehicles")
p3 <- plot_attribute_distribution(tires, "Tires")
p4 <- plot_attribute_distribution(gliders, "Gliders")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
ggsave("attribute_distributions.png", width = 12, height = 10)
```

```{r}
# Preparation for STAN model
# Improve the record data and ensure record data integrity
records_for_model <- records_with_combined_attributes %>%
  select(Score, Character, Vehicle, Tires, Glider, all_of(attributes)) %>%
  na.omit()

# Creating components mappings for STAN 
character_mapping <- data.frame(
  Character = unique(records_for_model$Character),
  CharacterID = 1:length(unique(records_for_model$Character))
)

vehicle_mapping <- data.frame(
  Vehicle = unique(records_for_model$Vehicle),
  VehicleID = 1:length(unique(records_for_model$Vehicle))
)

tire_mapping <- data.frame(
  Tires = unique(records_for_model$Tires),
  TireID = 1:length(unique(records_for_model$Tires))
)

glider_mapping <- data.frame(
  Glider = unique(records_for_model$Glider),
  GliderID = 1:length(unique(records_for_model$Glider))
)

# Add mapped components to record data
records_for_model <- records_for_model %>%
  left_join(character_mapping, by = "Character") %>%
  left_join(vehicle_mapping, by = "Vehicle") %>%
  left_join(tire_mapping, by = "Tires") %>%
  left_join(glider_mapping, by = "Glider")

# Prepared the attributes matrix
character_attributes <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(character_mapping), ncol = length(attributes))
colnames(character_attributes) <- attributes
for (i in 1:nrow(character_mapping)) {
  character_name <- character_mapping$Character[i]
  attrs <- get_driver_attributes(character_name)
  if (!is.null(attrs)) {
    character_attributes[i,] <- as.numeric(attrs[, attributes])
  }
}

vehicle_attributes <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(vehicle_mapping), ncol = length(attributes))
colnames(vehicle_attributes) <- attributes
for (i in 1:nrow(vehicle_mapping)) {
  vehicle_name <- vehicle_mapping$Vehicle[i]
  attrs <- get_vehicle_attributes(vehicle_name)
  if (!is.null(attrs)) {
    vehicle_attributes[i,] <- as.numeric(attrs[, attributes])
  }
}

tire_attributes <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(tire_mapping), ncol = length(attributes))
colnames(tire_attributes) <- attributes
for (i in 1:nrow(tire_mapping)) {
  tire_name <- tire_mapping$Tires[i]
  attrs <- get_tire_attributes(tire_name)
  if (!is.null(attrs)) {
    tire_attributes[i,] <- as.numeric(attrs[, attributes])
  }
}

glider_attributes <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(glider_mapping), ncol = length(attributes))
colnames(glider_attributes) <- attributes
for (i in 1:nrow(glider_mapping)) {
  glider_name <- glider_mapping$Glider[i]
  attrs <- get_glider_attributes(glider_name)
  if (!is.null(attrs)) {
    glider_attributes[i,] <- as.numeric(attrs[, attributes])
  }
}
```

```{r}
# FINALLY! IT'S STAN TIME!
# STAN data
stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(records_for_model),
  D = nrow(character_mapping),
  V = nrow(vehicle_mapping),
  T = nrow(tire_mapping),
  G = nrow(glider_mapping),
  K = length(attributes),
  character = records_for_model$CharacterID,
  vehicle = records_for_model$VehicleID,
  tire = records_for_model$TireID,
  glider = records_for_model$GliderID,
  score = records_for_model$Score,
  character_attr = character_attributes,
  vehicle_attr = vehicle_attributes,
  tire_attr = tire_attributes,
  glider_attr = glider_attributes
)

# fix an error for score datat, making sure it is vector
stan_data$score <- as.vector(scale(stan_data$score))
```

```{r}
# STAN MODEL
# STAN!!
stan_model_code <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> N;                        // observation value
  int<lower=1> D;                        // character
  int<lower=1> V;                        // vehicle
  int<lower=1> T;                        // tire
  int<lower=1> G;                        // glider
  int<lower=1> K;                        // attributes
  
  int<lower=1, upper=D> character[N];    // character ID
  int<lower=1, upper=V> vehicle[N];      // vehicle ID
  int<lower=1, upper=T> tire[N];         // tire ID
  int<lower=1, upper=G> glider[N];       // glider ID
  
  vector[N] score;                       // standarlize score
  
  // attributes matrix
  matrix[D, K] character_attr;           // character attributes
  matrix[V, K] vehicle_attr;             // vehicle  attributes
  matrix[T, K] tire_attr;                // tire attributes
  matrix[G, K] glider_attr;              // glider attributes
}

parameters {
  real alpha;                            // global
  
  vector[D] character_effect;            // character effect
  vector[V] vehicle_effect;              // vehicle effect
  vector[T] tire_effect;                 // tire effect
  vector[G] glider_effect;               // glider effect
  
  // attributes weight
  vector[K] attr_weights;             
  
  // char vs vehicle interaction
  matrix[D, V] char_vehicle_interaction; 
  
  // sd
  real<lower=0> sigma_character;        
  real<lower=0> sigma_vehicle;          
  real<lower=0> sigma_tire;             
  real<lower=0> sigma_glider;          
  real<lower=0> sigma_interaction;      
  real<lower=0> sigma_y;                 // noise
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[N] mu;                          
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
    mu[i] = alpha + 
            character_effect[character[i]] + 
            vehicle_effect[vehicle[i]] + 
            tire_effect[tire[i]] + 
            glider_effect[glider[i]];
    
    mu[i] += char_vehicle_interaction[character[i], vehicle[i]];

    for (k in 1:K) {
      mu[i] += attr_weights[k] * 
              (character_attr[character[i], k] + 
               vehicle_attr[vehicle[i], k] + 
               tire_attr[tire[i], k] + 
               glider_attr[glider[i], k]);
    }
  }
}

model {
  // prior
  alpha ~ normal(0, 1);
  attr_weights ~ normal(0, 0.5);
  
  // components effect
  character_effect ~ normal(0, sigma_character);
  vehicle_effect ~ normal(0, sigma_vehicle);
  tire_effect ~ normal(0, sigma_tire);
  glider_effect ~ normal(0, sigma_glider);
  
  for (d in 1:D) {
    char_vehicle_interaction[d] ~ normal(0, sigma_interaction);
  }
  
  sigma_character ~ cauchy(0, 1);
  sigma_vehicle ~ cauchy(0, 1);
  sigma_tire ~ cauchy(0, 1);
  sigma_glider ~ cauchy(0, 1);
  sigma_interaction ~ cauchy(0, 0.5);
  sigma_y ~ cauchy(0, 1);
  
  // likelihood
  score ~ normal(mu, sigma_y);
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  vector[N] y_pred;
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
    log_lik[i] = normal_lpdf(score[i] | mu[i], sigma_y);
    y_pred[i] = normal_rng(mu[i], sigma_y);
  }
}
"
```

```{r}
# fit model
fit <- stan(
  model_code = stan_model_code,
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,          
  iter = 2000,        
  warmup = 1000,      
  thin = 1,          
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9, max_treedepth = 12)  
)
```

```{r}
# Posterior
posterior_samples <- rstan::extract(fit)

# Component effects
character_effects <- colMeans(posterior_samples$character_effect)
names(character_effects) <- character_mapping$Character

vehicle_effects <- colMeans(posterior_samples$vehicle_effect)
names(vehicle_effects) <- vehicle_mapping$Vehicle

tire_effects <- colMeans(posterior_samples$tire_effect)
names(tire_effects) <- tire_mapping$Tires

glider_effects <- colMeans(posterior_samples$glider_effect)
names(glider_effects) <- glider_mapping$Glider

# Attribute weight
attr_weights <- colMeans(posterior_samples$attr_weights)
names(attr_weights) <- attributes

# Character and vehicle interaction
char_vehicle_interaction <- apply(posterior_samples$char_vehicle_interaction, c(2, 3), mean)
rownames(char_vehicle_interaction) <- character_mapping$Character
colnames(char_vehicle_interaction) <- vehicle_mapping$Vehicle
```

```{r}
# Component effects plots
plot_component_effects <- function(effects, title, top_n = 20) {
  df <- data.frame(
    Component = names(effects),
    Effect = effects
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Effect)) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    mutate(Component = factor(Component, levels = Component[order(Effect, decreasing = TRUE)]))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Component, y = Effect, fill = Effect)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +  # Apply viridis gradient coloring
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "Effect Size") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
}

p1 <- plot_component_effects(character_effects, "Character Effects on Score (Based on World Records)")
p2 <- plot_component_effects(vehicle_effects, "Vehicle Effects on Score (Based on World Records)")
p3 <- plot_component_effects(tire_effects, "Tire Effects on Score (Based on World Records)")
p4 <- plot_component_effects(glider_effects, "Glider Effects on Score (Based on World Records)")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
ggsave("world_record_component_effects.png", width = 16, height = 12)
```

```{r}
# Combination Exploration Based on Attributes
# Apply attribute weights to all possible combinations to find theoretically optimal combinations
# First, create the standardization function (same as in the model)
standardize <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

# Generate all possible combinations (using all known data)
all_combinations <- expand.grid(
  Character = character_mapping$Character,
  Vehicle = vehicle_mapping$Vehicle,
  Tires = tire_mapping$Tires,
  Glider = glider_mapping$Glider
)

# Calculate combination score
calculate_combination_score <- function(character, vehicle, tire, glider) {
  # Get component effects
  char_effect <- character_effects[character]
  veh_effect <- vehicle_effects[vehicle]
  tire_effect <- tire_effects[tire]
  glider_effect <- glider_effects[glider]
  
  # Get interaction effects
  interaction <- char_vehicle_interaction[character, vehicle]
  
  # Get attributes
  char_attrs <- get_driver_attributes(character)
  veh_attrs <- get_vehicle_attributes(vehicle)
  tire_attrs <- get_tire_attributes(tire)
  glider_attrs <- get_glider_attributes(glider)
  
  if (is.null(char_attrs) || is.null(veh_attrs) || 
      is.null(tire_attrs) || is.null(glider_attrs)) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # Calculate total attributes
  total_attrs <- numeric(length(attributes))
  names(total_attrs) <- attributes
  
  for (attr in attributes) {
    total_attrs[attr] <- char_attrs[[attr]] + 
      veh_attrs[[attr]] + 
      tire_attrs[[attr]] + 
      glider_attrs[[attr]]
  }
  
  # Calculate attribute contribution
  attr_contribution <- sum(total_attrs * attr_weights)
  
  # Calculate total score
  total_score <- char_effect + veh_effect + tire_effect + glider_effect + 
    interaction + attr_contribution
  
  return(total_score)
}

# Calculating theoretical best combinations is computationally intensive,
# so we'll only calculate a subset of combinations
# Use the top 20 characters and vehicles, and top 10 tires and gliders
top_characters_names <- names(sort(character_effects, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
top_vehicles_names <- names(sort(vehicle_effects, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
top_tires_names <- names(sort(tire_effects, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
top_gliders_names <- names(sort(glider_effects, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])

# Generate possible combinations
top_combinations <- expand.grid(
  Character = top_characters_names,
  Vehicle = top_vehicles_names,
  Tires = top_tires_names,
  Glider = top_gliders_names
)

# Calculate score for each combination
scored_combinations <- top_combinations %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    PredictedScore = calculate_combination_score(Character, Vehicle, Tires, Glider)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(PredictedScore)) %>%
  arrange(desc(PredictedScore))

# Output top 10 theoretical best combinations
print("Theoretical Best Combinations (Based on World Record Data and Bayesian Model):")
print(head(scored_combinations, 10))

# Save top 50 combinations
write.csv(head(scored_combinations, 50), "top_50_predicted_combinations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Get the theoretical best combination
top_combo <- head(scored_combinations, 1)

# Calculate component contributions
char_effect <- character_effects[top_combo$Character]
veh_effect <- vehicle_effects[top_combo$Vehicle]
tire_effect <- tire_effects[top_combo$Tires]
glider_effect <- glider_effects[top_combo$Glider]
interaction <- char_vehicle_interaction[top_combo$Character, top_combo$Vehicle]

# Calculate attribute contributions
char_attrs <- get_driver_attributes(top_combo$Character)
veh_attrs <- get_vehicle_attributes(top_combo$Vehicle)
tire_attrs <- get_tire_attributes(top_combo$Tires)
glider_attrs <- get_glider_attributes(top_combo$Glider)

total_attrs <- numeric(length(attributes))
names(total_attrs) <- attributes

# Sum up attributes from all components
for (attr in attributes) {
  total_attrs[attr] <- char_attrs[[attr]] + 
    veh_attrs[[attr]] + 
    tire_attrs[[attr]] + 
    glider_attrs[[attr]]
}

# Calculate the weighted contribution of attributes to score
attr_contribution <- sum(total_attrs * attr_weights)

# 1. Component Effect Breakdown Visualization
# This shows how each component contributes to the overall score
contributions <- data.frame(
  Component = c("Character", "Vehicle", "Tires", "Glider", "Interaction Effect", "Attribute Weighting"),
  Effect = c(char_effect, veh_effect, tire_effect, glider_effect, interaction, attr_contribution)
)

# Effect value for fill (continuous) instead of Effect > 0 (discrete)
effect_plot <- ggplot(contributions, aes(x = reorder(Component, abs(Effect)), y = Effect, fill = Effect)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "tomato", mid = "white", high = "steelblue", midpoint = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Component Effect Breakdown for", top_combo$Character, "+", 
                    top_combo$Vehicle, "+", top_combo$Tires, "+", top_combo$Glider),
       x = "", y = "Effect") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# 2. Total Attributes Visualization
# This shows the final attribute values for the recommended combination
attr_df <- data.frame(
  Attribute = names(total_attrs),
  Value = total_attrs
)

attribute_plot <- ggplot(attr_df, aes(x = reorder(Attribute, Value), y = Value, fill = Value)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Total Attributes for Top Recommendation", x = "", y = "Value")

# 3. Top Combinations Table
# Save the top 10 recommended combinations
top_combinations_table <- head(scored_combinations, 10)

# 4. Combine visualizations into a single image
# This creates a vertically stacked visualization with both charts
grid.arrange(effect_plot, attribute_plot, ncol = 1)
ggsave("top_combination_analysis.png", width = 12, height = 10)

# Save the top combinations to a CSV file for reference
write.csv(top_combinations_table, "top_10_combinations.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Print details of the best combination to console

cat("Character:", top_combo$Character, "\n")
cat("Vehicle:", top_combo$Vehicle, "\n")
cat("Tires:", top_combo$Tires, "\n")
cat("Glider:", top_combo$Glider, "\n")
cat("Predicted Score:", top_combo$PredictedScore, "\n")
